text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're not half-asleep, are you, 
Nakayama... The real deal, the Natto GOHAN 
game, starts right now!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Never heard of that one either, what 
kind of game is that...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You always show me a world I've never 
known, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on, Nakayama. Let's wager the 
sauce, and our lives, on this!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer...! We'll talk later, just 
stand over there and watch for now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is laughing happily. I'm 
not sure what's about to start, but after 
getting plenty of rest, she seems full of 
energy!
